issues: Absence of API Rate-Limiter: vulnerable to Denial of Service (DoS).
No memory profiling/allocation tracing for on-device inference.
Model ingestion processes lack automatic Quantization/optimization guards, leading to high latency on lower-end devices.
Fairness Audit: ML training does not evaluate model performance across demographic subgroups, triggering performance gaps on higher Fitzpatrick skin types.
Lack of temperature scaling or Platt calibration in training pipeline; output trust percentages are raw sigmoid values, misrepresenting real clinical certainty.
No automated testing infrastructure or unit tests found in the entire directory.
No localized dictionaries or standard clinical workflows for translation (only standard i18n shells).
No telemetry logging, HIPAA audit compliance, or data encryption measures established.
